limits: Judgment covers all 44 raw openings in the 12 supplied packets. Raw IDs are packet-local. Family definitions cover raw and post forms; merged post entries may contain multiple existing families.

The archive is frozen and incomplete. 'New' means a locally absent causal relation or explicit discriminator, not global originality. F07 remains uncertain because generic global allocation may subsume exchange cycles.

Every fit rating concerns the proposed bounded probe and its explicit implementation gates. Unknown demand feasibility, contact accuracy, attendance and administration savings do not themselves contradict hard commitments. None of these packets establishes eight-week success.

All raw openings have direct named-outcome or decision links and specific proposed discriminators; these scores rate assessability, not probability of benefit. Supplied observations motivate inferences but do not demonstrate proposed causal effects.

No new family appears only after Distill. P001 D1's equipment phrase is flagged literally as unsupported; it could be imprecise wording for absence of evidence of flexibility. Its principal allocation mechanism nevertheless survives.

P003 and P008 permit qualified outside-rehearsal credit. This must be distinguished from building-provided time when interpreting fulfillment; neither proposes dropping the weekly building-access guarantee, so no definite hard-constraint violation is inferred.

No parked-only opening was found, and no unresolved hard-commitment fit is promoted as established usability. P006 retains its raw uncertainty while recommending bounded comparison and rejection of violating schedules.
No method label was sought or confidently identified. These are authored synthetic packets with no measured actual-world outcome.
